_comment: The one list of in-app products. Read by scripts/gen-storekit.mjs (ios/App/GraveGoods.storekit), scripts/asc-products.mjs (App Store Connect), the build (www payments.js gets the ids and fallback prices) and docs/PLAY-PRODUCTS in store/play-listing.md. Prices are US-dollar base prices; Apple and Google convert them for other storefronts. v1 sells exactly one thing.

products.reviewNote: Buy: Settings > Remove ads. Restore: Settings > Restore purchases.

localizations.description: Removes every ad, for good. Nothing else changes: the whole game is free for everyone.
